idea-plugin.name: True Dark
idea-plugin.description:
True Dark Theme Collection

Version 3.0.0 - 6 themes with Xcode 16 syntax colors, now with first-class New UI (Islands) support.

A premium theme collection built around the Xcode 16 color palette, offering pure black, dark, and light variants for both Classic and New UI (Islands) interfaces. All colors target WCAG AA contrast ratios for optimal readability.

Theme Collection (6 Themes):

Classic UI:

  • True Black: Pure #000000 background with maximum contrast
  • True Dark: Softer #121212 background for reduced eye strain
  • True Light: High-contrast light theme with #F1F4FF background

New UI (Islands):

  • True Black Islands: Pure black with Islands toolbar, tabs, and widgets
  • True Dark Islands: Dark variant with full Islands UI integration
  • True Light Islands: Light variant optimized for the New UI

Xcode 16 Syntax Palette:

  • Keywords: Warm pink (#FF7AB2) with bold weight
  • Strings: Coral (#FF8170) for easy scanning
  • Types: Bright cyan (#6BDFFF) for class visibility
  • Functions: Teal (#5AC8DB) declarations, green-teal (#78C2B3) calls
  • Comments: Balanced gray (#7F8C98) visible on any background
  • Constants: Soft purple (#B281EB) for static members

Perfect for:

  • New UI Users: Islands themes with MainToolbar, RunWidget, and SegmentedButton styling
  • Classic UI Users: Upgraded classic themes with the same Xcode 16 palette
  • All JetBrains IDEs: IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, PyCharm, PhpStorm, Rider, and more
  • Long Coding Sessions: WCAG AA contrast ratios reduce eye strain
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Version 3.0.0 - Islands + Xcode 16 Upgrade

New UI (Islands) Support

  • 3 NEW THEMES: True Black Islands, True Dark Islands, True Light Islands
  • Full Islands UI integration: MainToolbar, RunWidget, SegmentedButton, GotItTooltip
  • ToolWindow.HeaderTab, MainWindow.Tab, Banner, HelpTooltip styling
  • DragAndDrop feedback and StatusBar.Widget states
  • parent_scheme=Islands Dark / Islands Light for proper New UI inheritance

Xcode 16 Color Palette

  • ALL 6 THEMES now use the Xcode 16 refined syntax palette
  • Keywords: #FF7AB2 (warm pink), Strings: #FF8170 (coral)
  • Types: #6BDFFF (bright cyan), Functions: #5AC8DB / #78C2B3
  • Comments: #7F8C98 (balanced gray), Constants: #B281EB (soft purple)
  • Selection: #2A3A5C (blue-tinted contextual selection)
  • All colors target WCAG AA contrast ratio (>= 4.5:1)

Architecture

  • 6 themes total: 3 Classic UI + 3 Islands / New UI
  • Backward compatible - existing Classic themes preserved and upgraded
  • Extended IDE compatibility range for New UI support
